title: Unique Charred Uruguayan Long Bean Skillet
description: A charred, crisp, and delicious Uruguayan dish featuring long beans, perfect for a brunch mood, made with beurre monte and ovo-vegetarian friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the butter to melt.
Add the garlic and red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the long beans to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until they start to char.
Season the long beans with salt and black pepper and continue to cook for another 2 minutes.
Push the long beans to one side of the skillet and crack in the eggs.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through and then mix with the long beans.
Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top of the long bean and egg mixture and cook until melted.
Stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Serve the skillet hot and enjoy.
